product_overview: A luxury jewelry e-commerce frontend built with Next.js and TypeScript that supports browsing, filtering, 3D product viewing, cart/checkout, account management, appointment booking, and a full admin panel for product and order management.
core_goals: Provide a polished, responsive storefront for browsing and purchasing jewelry with animated hero and product experiences.
Enable users to register, sign in, manage an account, view orders, and book appointments.
Support a complete cart and checkout flow with order creation and confirmation.
Offer an admin dashboard for full CRUD of products, categories, orders, appointments, and analytics.
Surface real data via API routes and prepare the app for Supabase and Stripe integration.

features.name: Homepage
features.description: Landing page showcasing the hero, rings by style, diamond shapes, categories, featured products, testimonials, and CTAs to drive users into product browsing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View hero section with animations -> Browse rings by style section -> Browse diamond shapes section -> Click CTA button -> Navigate to /collection -> See product grid
Navigate to / -> Loading state appears for featured products -> See featured products after load -> Click featured product -> Navigate to /products/[slug]
Navigate to / -> API for featured products fails -> See user-friendly error message for featured products

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate returning users with email and password, with optional remember-me and password visibility toggle.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Check remember me checkbox -> Click Sign In button -> Redirect to /account -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Sign In button with invalid credentials -> See error message on invalid credentials
Navigate to /login -> Click toggle password visibility -> Password field toggles between hidden and visible

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Register new users via a signup form that validates inputs and confirms successful registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signup -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Fill confirm password field -> Click Create Account button -> Redirect to /auth/signup-success -> See signup confirmation

Navigate to /auth/signup -> Fill name field -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Fill confirm password field mismatched -> Click Create Account button -> See validation error messages about password mismatch
Navigate to /auth/signup -> Submit form with missing required field -> See validation error messages

features.name: Product Collection
features.description: Browse the full product collection with filters for category, style, diamond shape, price range, sorting, quick view, and add-to-cart actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /collection -> View product grid -> Filter by category -> Filter by ring style -> Filter by diamond shape -> Adjust price range slider -> See filtered results
Navigate to /collection -> Use sort dropdown to sort by price -> See products resorted
Navigate to /collection -> Use search field -> Type query -> See live filtered results
Navigate to /collection -> Click product Quick View -> Quick view modal opens -> Click Add to Cart in modal -> See cart updated
Navigate to /collection -> Apply filters that yield no matches -> See 'No products found' message

features.name: Product Detail
features.description: Detailed product page with image gallery, 3D model viewer, variant selection, product details, and add-to-cart/wishlist controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[slug] -> View product images in gallery -> Click a thumbnail -> Main image updates -> Switch to another image -> See image change
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Click to open 3D model viewer -> View 3D model of the product -> Close 3D model viewer
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Select product variant or size -> Click Add to Cart button -> See cart count update or confirmation
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Click Add to Wishlist button -> See wishlist confirmation
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Click Add to Cart when product is out of stock -> See out of stock error message

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Cart page showing items, quantities, and order summary with controls to update quantities, remove items, and proceed to checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> View cart items with images and prices -> Increase item quantity -> See subtotal update -> Decrease item quantity -> See subtotal update
Navigate to /cart -> Click remove item button -> Item is removed from cart -> See updated order summary
Navigate to /cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout button -> Navigate to /checkout -> See checkout form
Navigate to /cart -> Open cart while no items present -> See 'Your cart is empty' message -> Click Continue shopping link -> Navigate to /collection

features.name: Checkout
features.description: Collect shipping and payment information, allow shipping method selection, review order summary, and place orders via API.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill shipping address form -> Select shipping method -> Enter payment information -> Review order summary -> Click Place order -> POST to /api/checkout -> Navigate to /order/success -> See order confirmation
Navigate to /checkout -> Fill shipping address form -> Enter invalid payment details -> Click Place order -> Receive payment declined response -> See payment error message and remain on /checkout
Navigate to /checkout -> Attempt to place order with empty cart -> See validation error message preventing order placement

features.name: User Account
features.description: Authenticated user dashboard displaying profile info, order history, appointments, wishlist, and profile update actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> Authenticate if required -> See personal profile information and order history -> Click an order -> View order details
Navigate to /account -> Update profile details -> Click Save -> See confirmation that profile was updated
Navigate to /account -> Click Logout -> Be redirected to /login
Navigate to /account without authentication -> Be redirected to /login or see access denied

features.name: Appointments Booking
features.description: Booking interface for jewelry consultations where users select date/time, specify contact info and appointment type, and submit booking requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments -> Select appointment date -> Select appointment time -> Select appointment type -> Fill contact information -> Click Submit booking request -> POST to /api/appointments -> See booking confirmation
Navigate to /appointments -> Select a date/time that is already booked -> Click Submit booking request -> Receive conflict response -> See error message about unavailable slot
Navigate to /appointments -> Leave required field empty -> Click Submit booking request -> See validation error messages

features.name: Header Navigation
features.description: Site header providing main navigation, search, cart access, account access, and responsive mobile menu toggle.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use header menu to click Shop or Collection link -> Navigate to /collection
Navigate to any page -> Use header search input -> Type query -> See live search results or navigate to /shop with filtered results
Navigate to any page -> Click cart icon in header -> Open cart drawer or navigate to /cart -> See cart contents
Navigate to any page on mobile -> Click mobile menu toggle -> Mobile menu opens -> Click a nav item -> Navigate to the selected route
Navigate to any page -> Use header search with no matching products -> See 'No results' message

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated admin area for viewing analytics and performing full CRUD on products, categories, diamond shapes, orders, users, inventory, appointments, blog posts, messaging, and reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> See dashboard analytics overview

Navigate to /admin -> Click sidebar link to /admin/products -> View products list -> Click Add Product -> Fill product form (name, category, price, metal, slug) -> Click Add Product -> POST to /api/products -> See new product in list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Click edit icon on a product -> Modify details -> Click Save -> See updated product in list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Click delete icon on a product -> Confirm deletion -> DELETE to /api/products/[id] -> See product removed from list
Navigate to /admin -> Click /admin/orders -> View orders list -> Change an order status -> Save -> See updated status in list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Submit new product with missing required fields -> See validation error messages and product not created

known_limitations.issue: Login uses localStorage-based authentication instead of Supabase Auth
known_limitations.impact: Authentication is not secure and is only client-side

known_limitations.issue: Cart state is managed in localStorage
known_limitations.impact: Cart data is per-device and not synced across devices
